fonts.display: 'ui-sans-serif', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Circular Bold', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Cream Paper
palette.role: Page canvas, section backgrounds — the warm off-white ground that softens every interface layer and gives the whole product its café-on-paper atmosphere

palette.name: Card White
palette.role: Card surfaces, modal backgrounds, raised panels — pure white floats above the cream canvas to create depth through luminance contrast rather than color

palette.name: Hairline Gray
palette.role: Borders, dividers, icon outlines, badge outlines — used at 1146+ occurrences as the universal hairline separator across cards, buttons, and inputs

palette.name: Ink Black
palette.role: Primary text, filled icon strokes, high-contrast UI elements — the dominant text and icon color across the entire product

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Body and heading text, filled SVG strokes — slightly softer than pure black for sustained reading in longer copy blocks

palette.name: Fog Gray
palette.role: Muted helper text, secondary metadata, small caps labels — the quietest text voice for timestamps, supporter counts, and contextual hints

palette.name: Marigold
palette.role: Yellow wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Buttercup
palette.role: Yellow wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Terracotta
palette.role: Orange outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Blush Border
palette.role: Soft warm border accent for notification cards and supporter activity popovers — bridges Terracotta's intensity into a gentle outline
